title: Migration 37 — Storage bucket privacy (buckets only)
description: Applies migration 37, runs VERIFY A-C, then rolls back on a disposable PostgreSQL 18 cluster. Migration 37 now covers BUCKETS ONLY: it asserts public = false on both farmer buckets and creates farmer-photos private. The object policies were split into migration 38 because they require OWNERSHIP of storage.objects while a bucket write needs only table privileges -- coupling them meant the achievable half could not be applied either. The rollback deliberately leaves bucket privacy at public = false (a rollback must not reintroduce a vulnerability), so postRollback asserts the buckets remain present rather than removed. The destructive bucket-deletion path is guarded by SET LOCAL bucket_privacy.rollback_destructive and is NOT exercised here; the default no-opt-in path is.

verify.note: A and C are the assertions. B and D are INFORMATIONAL BY DESIGN and emit no PASSED token: B reports migration 38's policy state (absent is correct here) and D reports migration 22's overlay. Declaring either as an expected pass would force it to assert something migration 37 does not install. The whole file is catalog-SELECT only -- no auth.users fixture, no DML in any section -- so unlike every other VERIFY in this corpus it is safe to run whole against Production under the change freeze.
